flagged.title: Life Chances
flagged.reason: The video states that Goldthorpe and Lockwood claimed workers were undergoing embourgeoisement, when their famous study actually tested and rejected that thesis.

mark_affecting.quote: They claimed that because these manual workers were suddenly earning much higher wages, they were undergoing embourgeoisement.

flagged.title: Researching Stratification, Crime and Inequality
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly presents Fiona Devine's Luton restudy as an example of a longitudinal study, teaching students an incorrect research method classification for a key named study.

mark_affecting.quote: Another really interesting way to measure stratification is across time, using a longitudinal study. A great example of this is Fiona Devine, returning to Luton to revisit the exact same type of workers that sociologists Goldthorpe and Lockwood had studied years earlier.
